bypass mux selects register (byp=1) or live wire (byp=0).
Mesh outputs are combinational (not registered): N/S/W/E_in → *_out within the
same cycle, so one value can traverse several PEs per clock (HyCUBE / SMART bypass).

pc ≥ end or pc < start: pc ← start
2-cycle load latency is handled by AGU / DMEM
P pred (rsvd) · I imm-valid · F use-float (rsvd) · B ALU-bypass (rsvd) · A AGU trigger · U update RES · switch codes: 0 E_in, 1 S_in, 2 W_in, 3 N_in, 4 ALU_out, 5 ALU_res, 7 open

svg.text: Fig. 1. Re-created PACE processing element: 16 × 64b configuration memory with loop/PC controller, 6 × 7 single-cycle multi-hop router with four parking registers, and 16b INT + 8 × FP8 SIMD ALU.
